title: Your identity is not defined by your worst moments.
paragraphs: Your identity is not defined by your worst moments.

Not by the mistakes you regret.
Not by the anxiety you battle.
Not by the failures you remember.
Your identity is found in Jesus.

Through Him, you are forgiven.
Through Him, you are redeemed.
Through Him, you are chosen and deeply loved.
"In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of sins." — Ephesians 1:7
